info.title: RYDO PILOT — PROPOSED contract, NOT runtime API
info.description: Design contract for integration; every operation is NOT implemented at this baseline. Runtime Swagger remains cmd/rydo-api/swagger/openapi.json (health only). Do not replace/embed/advertise this artifact as served functionality. P01–P08 are reversible local contract proposals documented in README.md, not changes to PRD/API source.

post.description: Verify LINE ID token server-side; upsert verified subject; create a 30-day app session and revoke session represented by replaced cookie in same transaction. Never trust client accountId. Access token stays in memory. Set HttpOnly refresh cookie (see response header).

post.description: Authenticate and validate syntax/required headers first. Serialize by (user,key); compare fingerprint (method, concrete path, normalized supplied body, exact preview token). Matching committed unexpired response replays BEFORE preview expiry/date/version checks. Different fingerprint409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Without replay: ownership404, then active date conflict409 SESSION_DATE_EXISTS (P08), then preview verification409 PREVIEW_STALE. Missing/invalid required confirmation header422 VALIDATION_ERROR. DB transaction atomically commits session+children+response; unique active user/date is final concurrency guard. Expired key: client reloads current record before resubmit; no replay guarantee beyond24h. Create snapshots cost settings after locking/rechecking current vehicle values against preview. Return only id/version/summary, then GET detail for frontend SavedDay.

patch.description: Authenticate; same-key replay/fingerprint precedence as create, before preview/version checks. Lock owned active session; verify preview base version atomically; VERSION_CHANGED returns409 PREVIEW_STALE with reason, reload detail before new preview/confirmation. Use original snapshot even if vehicle changed; atomically replace supplied children, increment version and store replay response. No work_date/vehicle/snapshot edits. GET detail after response. P04 normalization preserves omitted-vs-supplied field set.

Date.description: Valid calendar date, not after today in Asia/Bangkok. Proposed supported range 0001-01-01..9999-12-31 (P07); server checks today dynamically.

Note.description: Provisional P01: <=1000 Unicode code points; omitted on create becomes empty string; null rejected.

MoneyInput.description: Nonnegative decimal string; no sign, exponent, comma or whitespace. Leading zeros permitted. DB precision/scale enforced; 32-character cap is provisional P01.

Distance.description: Nonnegative decimal string; no sign, exponent, comma or whitespace. Leading zeros permitted. DB precision/scale enforced; 32-character cap is provisional P01.

Hours.description: 0..24 decimal hours, at most two fractional digits. Never HH:mm. Numeric limits agree with current profit code; length cap P01.

Efficiency.description: Nonnegative decimal string; no sign, exponent, comma or whitespace. Leading zeros permitted. DB precision/scale enforced; 32-character cap is provisional P01.

FuelPrice.description: Nonnegative decimal string; no sign, exponent, comma or whitespace. Leading zeros permitted. DB precision/scale enforced; 32-character cap is provisional P01.

Reserve.description: Nonnegative decimal string; no sign, exponent, comma or whitespace. Leading zeros permitted. DB precision/scale enforced; 32-character cap is provisional P01.

NonnegativeAmount.description: Calculated output, not limited to individual input-column precision; totals can exceed it.

SignedAmount.description: Calculated output can be negative; normalize negative zero to 0.00.

NullableRate.description: null only when the corresponding denominator is zero.

id_token.description: Synthetic examples are placeholders. Never log real tokens. Provisional token-size bound P01.

Auth.description: expires_in is capped at the original app-session expiry; refresh never extends the 30-day lifetime. display_name may be null (P03); openid-only login must not fabricate a name.

VehiclePatch.description: P04: partial object; omitted fields retained, null/empty object rejected. is_default may only be true.

incomes.description: Unique platform_code, not merely unique whole rows. New codes must be active; saved inactive codes may remain on edit.

expenses.description: P01: <=100 rows. No actual fuel entries.

SessionPatch.description: P04: at least one field; omitted retains value, provided arrays replace completely. expenses:[] clears; incomes:[] invalid. null rejected; note:"" clears. Date, vehicle and snapshot cannot be supplied. Frontend edit adapter must strip work_date and vehicle_id.

Summary.description: Map profit.Summary explicitly to these JSON field names. Calculate with exact decimal/rational arithmetic; round fuel and reserve separately half away from zero to two places, sum rounded costs, then net, then rates. No rounding of distance/efficiency intermediate.

Preview.description: Signed opaque token binds verified user, normalized request, target/create or session ID+version, original cost snapshot and 15-minute expiry. Preview writes no financial records.

Confirmation.description: Original API §6 minimal response. Not SavedDay: frontend must GET detail after confirmation (P06). JSON-safe integer version cap is provisional P01; never silently round a BIGINT.

incomes.description: Unique platform_code, not merely unique whole rows. New codes must be active; saved inactive codes may remain on edit.

expenses.description: P01: <=100 rows. No actual fuel entries.

SavedDay.description: P02 exact read shape aligned to frontend SavedDay. Normalize absent DB notes to empty string; never expose user_id or mutable snapshot fields. Snapshot remains server-owned and is used for every read/edit calculation.

PageMeta.description: P02: no total required; order by work_date DESC, id DESC; active records only, inclusive from/to. Default page=1, page_size=20, max=100.

Error.description: P05 typed array retains original error.details array. Original five named codes preserved; generic codes/detail variants proposed. Validation field paths use incomes[0].gross_income etc. SESSION_DATE_EXISTS includes own session_id; version mismatch uses PREVIEW_STALE + VERSION_CHANGED, client must reload detail before new preview.

Origin.description: Must exactly equal configured WEB_APP_URL origin. Validate even on login/logout with missing cookies; forwarded Origin must be preserved by proxy.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Per-user UUID per confirmation; 24-hour successful replay. New input/new preview requires new key.
